fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Event slug from the event config

fields.name: enriched_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the enrichment row was produced

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: LLM model identifier used for stance labelling

fields.name: embedding_model_id
fields.description: Embedding model identifier used for text vectors

fields.name: lang
fields.description: BCP-47 language tag (hi-en for Hinglish, und for empty text)

fields.name: embedding
fields.description: Embedding vector for the item text

fields.name: storyline_id
fields.description: Nearest storyline centre above assign_threshold, else unassigned

fields.name: storyline_similarity
fields.description: Cosine similarity to the best-matching storyline centre

fields.name: second_similarity
fields.description: Cosine similarity to the second-best storyline centre

fields.name: off_topic
fields.description: True if matched keywords.exclude or below offtopic_floor

fields.name: claims
fields.description: Verified claim stances aggregated across prompt paraphrases

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Config entity keys matched in the item text

fields.name: is_official
fields.description: True if author is an official account or text quotes a configured spokesperson

fields.name: conflict_person
fields.description: Configured conflicts_of_interest person named in text or matching author
